text:
Julie (AE): FYI — Acme Bank POC is stalled. They sent a giant security questionnaire and legal redlines. Buyer says no hosted endpoints unless we do VPC peering + dedicated infra. Need exec support.

Tom (SE): Quick summary of asks from the customer call today:
- SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning
- VPC peering or private deployment (no internet-facing endpoints)
- SOC2 Type II report and results from latest pentest
- 99.95% SLA for production, but POC just needs isolation for data

Maria (Security): We can share SOC2 report and pen test summary (sanitized). VPC peering is doable for Dedicated/Private, but requires network config from their infra team (CIDR, BGP? VPN). For POC we can offer an isolated VPC with ephemeral creds — still need their infra contact.

Ash (Eng Lead): Technical tradeoffs: Private bundle (on-prem or VPC) => infra lead time ~10-14 business days for a secure build + QA. If they accept a limited-scope Hosted POC we can lock down data (no retention) and run in a dedicated tenant with prefix caching disabled — can be done in ~48-72 hours.

Julie (AE): They're pushing for on-prem for compliance. Sales asked for a timeline + cost delta. Also they want pricing for a 12mo commit if we can hit their SLA.

Sarah (VP Sales): @Julie we should escalate to execs. What are the absolute must-haves vs nice-to-haves? If on-prem is a blocker, what's the minimum discount and committed ARR needed to justify Private deployment?

Tom (SE): Must-haves (customer): VPC/private endpoint, SAML, SOC2. Nice-to-have: full on-prem (they prefer but said VPC could work). From engineering POV, VPC + dedicated capacity is much faster.

Dylan (Legal): Send me the customer's redline doc. We can fast-track ECA review for enterprise commitments > $250k ARR. SLA: we can discuss 99.9% vs 99.95% depending on multi-region setup. Need to see indemnity/liability caps in their redlines.

Julie (AE): Adding links: POC brief + SSO notes: https://docs.internal/redwood/pocs/acme-bank
POC ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-312

deploy-bot: POC environment created [env-id: poc-acme-2024-04] (provisioning started) :gear:

Maria (Security): Checklist I'm asking the customer to fill out:
```
- Network contact + allowed CIDR
- SAML IdP metadata
- Data classification addendum (PII/financial)
- Penetration test scope for POC
```

Ash (Eng Lead): If legal signs off on redlines we can prioritize a dedicated cluster. ETA for VPC peering setup: 3 business days after we get CIDR and firewall rules. Full Private (on-prem) still 2+ weeks.

Sarah (VP Sales): Julie — recommend we offer two tracks to the customer and align with their procurement timeline:
1) Fast-track isolated Dedicated POC (VPC peering) — 3 business days to demo; pricing: discounted POC rate + option to convert to 12mo reserved capacity.
2) Full Private deployment — for enterprise contract only, +35% implementation fee, 2–3 weeks lead time.

Julie (AE): Customer asked about discount range. How low can we go on price for a 12mo commit if they convert after POC?

Tom (SE): We have room to offer up to 30% off list for a 12mo commit depending on committed GPUs/throughput. Sarah can confirm final approval.

Sarah (VP Sales): I can approve up to 25% off in-line. Any deeper discount needs CRO sign-off. If they land at >$500k ARR, escalate and we can push to 35% with implementation fees covered.

Dylan (Legal): Action from legal: I will review their redlines today — need their tracked PDF. Send to dl@redwood.com.

Julie (AE): I have a follow-up call with their CTO at 16:00 PT. I'll ask for the network contact and tracked redlines.

Maria (Security): Also note: customer is asking for a clause to delete raw logs immediately after POC sessions. We can add a data retention config but need product/ops to confirm feasibility.

Ash (Eng Lead): We can implement retention config for the POC env (no token logs retained). Ops will need 24 hours to put the config in place.

Julie (AE): TL;DR / Actions: 
- Julie: get their network contact + tracked redlines by EOD (customer call 16:00 PT)
- Dylan: legal to review redlines and propose ECA comments (EOD)
- Maria: prepare SOC2 + pen test artifacts and retention config statement (today)
- Ash/Tom: estimate cost + ETA for dedicated POC and retention config (today)
- Sarah: approve up to 25% discount; hold CRO approval path for deeper discounts

Tom (SE): I'll draft a short technical one-pager to share on the call.

Sarah (VP Sales): Exec note: If the deal slips because of on-prem requirement, escalate to me immediately. We should avoid losing momentum.

Julie (AE): Will report back after call. Thanks everyone :pray:
